ui.story: Imaging viewers usually select studies and series before opening instance headers. At billions of instances, indexing every header makes routine access expensive. This strategy retains the customer model while adding typed catalogs, optional bounded object-store metadata bundles, and governed research sidecars.
ui.how_it_works: Import studies first, deriving a flat series catalog. Add instances progressively with numeric ordering and validated series ownership. Keep complete metadata inline or in immutable bundles. Promote selected top-level tags for one modality and rebuild bounded series pages. All runtime surfaces use the same strategy operation contracts. Discover the active query catalog, combine promoted tag predicates, and hydrate selected headers in bounded series batches.
benefits: Fast catalog paths with a small regular-index plan
Detailed metadata can be retrieved separately
Research fields are opt-in and versioned
Synthetic metadata supports a safe public builder journey
constraints: Preview; 15-billion-instance scale has not been benchmarked
Research results require an explicit partial-coverage acknowledgement
No pixel delivery or standard DICOMweb server is included
Shard key selection and archival execution require deployment-specific work
